title: Senior Accountant
description:
Roles and Responsibilities 
 Manage day-to-day accounting operations, including billing, invoicing, and accounts receivable.
 Prepare financial statements, balance sheets, and tax returns (GST & Income Tax).
 Ensure accurate bookkeeping records using Tally ERP software.
 Conduct general accounting tasks such as journal entries, reconciliations, and bank reconciliations.
 Provide support for finalizing accounts and ensuring compliance with company policies.
 Desired Candidate Profile 
 2-5 years of experience in finance or accounting role.
 B.Com degree from a recognized university.
 Proficiency in Tally ERP, GST filing, income tax return preparation, balance sheet management.
 Strong understanding of finance concepts including budgeting, forecasting, cost control.
 Language Hindi(Mandatory), Local Language

Key Skills: senior accountant,Tally,Tally ERP,GST,Accounts Finalisation,TDS,Finance,General Accounting
